title: INshop
blurb: Design a store, arcade, gallery, café, bookstore, makerspace, computer lab, toy store or lounge in 3D: draw rooms, hallways and floors, add stairs and stages, pick door and window styles, and place 90+ props, lights, posters with your own images and imported 3D models. Switch between day, overcast and night, then walk through it on screen or in VR.
controls: Add tab: click an item, then click the floor to place it. Drag to move, R rotates, W draws walls, Ctrl+Z undoes. Plan for top view, Walk for first person (WASD). Enter VR on a headset: trigger to teleport, left stick walks, right stick turns.
